question: What is the meaning of recycled percentage in relation to end of life scenario?
description: The recycled percentage in relation to end of life scenario refers to the proportion of materials that are prepared to return into pure-type material cycles at the end of life. This is calculated based on the total weight of all materials used in the building. The sensitivity analysis with a 20% reduction to the recoverable content of all products still shows a high circularity, indicating the importance of correct material handling during the end of life phase.
